caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a man resembling Benjamin Franklin, rendered in shades of brown and tan, giving the appearance of carved wood. The man has long hair parted in the middle, prominent facial features including a high forehead, pronounced cheeks, a slightly open mouth, and detailed wrinkles. He wears a jacket featuring large buttons and buttonholes, as well as a shirt with visible ruffled fabric at the chest. A distinct dark crack runs vertically down the right side of the face and chest, further emphasizing the wooden appearance. The bust is positioned on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature, "Lawrence Hymn 1975," is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Figurehead: Benjamin Franklin
